files.file: Main page component: displays Economic Data Performance Tracker heatmap + tab navigation for Yield Curve and Volatility tabs

types.type: Union type: 'yield-curve' | 'vix'. Defines available page tabs.
Union type: 'Tame' | 'Hot' | 'Mixed' | 'Dovish' | 'Hawkish' | null. Qualitative assessment of indicator readings.
Key fields: status (IndicatorStatus), value (number | null), unit (string). Single cell in heatmap grid.
Key fields: value (number | null), percentile (number | null, 1-100). Monthly value with percentile rank from Yang PKL data.
Key fields: p10, p25, p50, p75, p90 (all number | null). Historical percentile thresholds for an indicator.
Key fields: name (string), bbg_ticker (string), unit (string), values (Record<month, MacroMonthlyValue>), thresholds (MacroPercentileThresholds). Single macro indicator.

page_structure.panel: MacroHeatmap panel displaying all 73+ macroeconomic indicators in 10 expandable categories with two display modes: - Value Mode: Trailing 12-month view with percentile-colored cells - Position Mode: Latest percentile + historical thresholds (p10, p25, p50, p75, p90) Features: Collapsible groups, drill-down modal on indicator click, legend with percentile scale
page_structure.tab: YieldCurveTab displays USD Treasury yield curve from 1M to 30Y maturity with three snapshots: - Current (green, solid line) - 1 Month Ago (amber, dashed line) - 1 Year Ago (red, dashed line) — optional, depends on FRED data availability Features: Curve shape (Inverted/Flat/Normal), 2s10s spread, 30Y yield, toggleable curves, stat cards, yield change mini bars

VolatilityTab shows VIX and MOVE volatility indices with toggle between them: - Left panel: AI-generated summary of volatility regime and implications - Right panel: Speedometer gauge with current value, regime, percentile bar, 1D/1W/1M changes - Bottom panel: Historical time series with percentile-based regime bands (10th/25th/50th/75th/90th), time window selector (1Y/3Y/5Y/10Y/Max) Features: Regime color coding, asymmetric y-axis compression for VIX spikes, regime band labels

styling_notes.color_scheme: All chart hex colors imported from @/lib/chartColors PALETTE (migrated 2026-04-07). 1-20%: nativeGreen500 — Low/good for negative indicators 21-40%: lime500 — Below Average 41-60%: yellow500 — Normal/Median 61-80%: orange500 — Above Average 81-100%: red500 — High/bad for negative indicators Heatmap cell backgrounds still use inline rgba() with dynamic opacity (functional, not hardcoded hex).
styling_notes.accessibility: Tooltips with help icons for all major components Color-blind friendly via text labels + percentile numbers Keyboard accessible dropdowns and toggles

performance_notes.optimization: VolatilityTab: Filters historical data by time window, then samples every 3rd point (or last point) for rendering YieldCurveTab: Uses recharts ResponsiveContainer for responsive sizing
MacroTimeSeriesModal: useMemo for filteredData, filteredThresholds, currentPercentile, yDomain to prevent unnecessary recalculations VolatilityTab: useMemo for filteredData in HistoricalChart
performance_notes.asymmetric_compression: VolatilityTab VIX chart uses asymmetric y-axis transform (linear below 25, compressed above) to keep typical volatility range readable while compressing extreme spikes

integration_notes.data_as_of_registry: Both MacroHeatmap and main Macroeconomics component register their data_as_of timestamps via useYangDataAsOf() hook for central freshness tracking
integration_notes.manifest_integration: MacroTimeSeriesModal fetches manifest timestamp via useDataFreshness() for footer attribution Panels use SmartPanelFooter with sourceKey="data_pkl" for consistent timestamp display
integration_notes.theme_context: Main page wraps content in PageThemeProvider with accentColor tied to --primary CSS variable
